description: Publish queue for the on-site social feed (/feed/). A pg_cron job calls the post-social-feed edge function daily at 15:00 UTC (see supabase/social_feed_automation.sql); the function fetches this file from the live site and inserts every pending entry whose post_date (America/New_York) has arrived into public.social_posts, deduped forever by queue id, so stale entries and repeat calls are harmless. A weekly routine refills pending with the coming week's posts drawn from releasing articles, facts that have photos in FACT_IMAGES, and Chronicles. Caption rules match docs/RULES.md and the social voice: hook first, no URLs in the caption (link_url carries the page), 2 to 4 #hashtags at the end, no em or en dashes, US spelling. media_url and link_url are site-relative; the function makes them absolute.

pending.caption: Ghost shrimp get added to an existing tank on impulse more than almost any other animal in the hobby. The setup is genuinely easy. The tankmates are where it goes wrong. #ghostshrimp #aquarium #shrimpkeeping
A cherry shrimp finishes molting, turns around, and eats the shell it just climbed out of. All that calcium is already paid for. Leave the molt in the tank. #cherryshrimp #aquarium #animalfacts

A zebra finch will not talk to you and will not sit on your finger, and pushing for either is how you end up with a stressed bird. What they offer instead is a quieter kind of pet entirely. #zebrafinch #birds #petbirds

The parrotlet is the smallest parrot commonly kept and seems to be the last to find out. The bite is much stronger than a budgie's, and an under-socialized one is a harder bird than its size suggests. #parrotlet #parrots #petbirds

A male satin bowerbird builds an avenue of twigs that is not a nest and never will be. It is a stage, he decorates it in blue, and he will steal blue from a rival's bower to do it. #bowerbird #birds #animalfacts
Part 17 of the Chronicles is up, and Dex has a case: The Case of the Missing Cricket. The suspect list is short and he is on it. Otis has a new part too. #chronicles #beardeddragon #petstories

Rats are one of the most hands-on small pets there is, and real biting is rare enough that most of what gets called a bite turns out to be something else. Knowing the difference changes how you handle them. #petrats #smallpets #rats

Mouse housing runs backwards from most small mammal advice. The glass tank that is the right call for a gerbil is specifically the wrong one for a mouse, and ammonia is the reason. #petmice #smallpets #miceofinstagram

Mice eating their own droppings is not a fixed habit, it is a nutrient reading. Fed a standard diet they did it about 9.6 times a day, and fortifying the food with B12 cut it right back. #mice #animalfacts #smallpets

Feed a red-footed tortoise like a sulcata and you are underfeeding it. This one is a real omnivore that needs real fruit and real animal protein, not a grazer having an occasional treat. #tortoise #redfootedtortoise #reptiles

A startled garter snake is far more likely to musk you than bite you, and new keepers rarely see it coming. It is a defensive reflex worth understanding rather than being put off by. #gartersnake #snakes #reptiles
